graders.evidence:
Verdict: request changes. Level: function. Concern: accessibility. Depth: default. Read `form.jsx` in full (16 lines). 2 block FAIL, 0 PASS, the rest N/A.

**FAIL [block] fn-form-control-has-label** (`form.jsx:5-10`, proven)
- The email `<input>` has only `placeholder="Email address"`. It has no `<label>`, no `id`, and no wrapping label.
- A screen reader announces it as a bare "edit text" field, and voice-control users have no name to say.
- The placeholder disappears once the user types.
- Fix: add `<label htmlFor="email">Email address</label>`, give the input `id="email"`, and add `autocomplete="email"` and `name="email"`.
- gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control` and axe `label`.

**FAIL [block] fn-native-button-or-link** (`form.jsx:11-13`, proven)
- The "Sign up" control is a `<div className="btn" onClick={onSubmit}>`.
- It isn't in the tab order, has no role, and ignores Enter and Space. Keyboard and screen-reader users can't reach or operate it, and it is announced as plain text.
- Fix: use `<button type="submit">Sign up</button>`. Drop the `onClick`, because the form's `onSubmit` already handles it. Reset `border`, `background` and `font` in CSS to keep the `.btn` look.
- gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events` and `jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions`.

N/A (applies_when does not hold): fn-aria-role-has-state-and-keys, fn-colour-not-sole-cue, fn-dialog-focus-managed, fn-error-says-what-and-how, fn-heading-structure, fn-img-alt-text, fn-no-positive-tabindex, fn-reduced-motion-respected, fn-related-controls-in-fieldset, fn-status-announced-live-region.

N/A - not read: fn-focus-indicator-visible and fn-target-size, because the CSS for `.btn` isn't in this file. Recheck both after the button change, and make sure the stylesheet doesn't set `outline: none`.

Not shown at default depth: the `discuss` card fn-label-above-field, which would be satisfied by placing the new label above the input.

Notes:
- `form.jsx` has no error or success feedback. If you add either, you'll need fn-error-says-what-and-how and fn-status-announced-live-region.
- `useState` is used without an import. That's a correctness issue and out of scope for this review.

**FAIL [block] `fn-form-control-has-label`, `form.jsx:5-10`** (proven)
The email `<input>` has only `placeholder="Email address"`. There is no `<label>`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
- The placeholder disappears once the user types.
- Screen readers announce the field as a bare "edit text", and voice-control users have no name to say.
- Fix: add `<label htmlFor="email">Email address</label>`, give the input `id="email"`, and add `autoComplete="email"`.
- Gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control`, axe `label`.

**FAIL [block] `fn-native-button-or-link`, `form.jsx:11-13`** (proven)
`<div className="btn" onClick={onSubmit}>` is the only submit control.
- It isn't in the tab order, has no button role, and ignores Enter and Space, so keyboard and screen-reader users can't submit from it.
- Fix: use `<button type="submit">Sign up</button>` and drop the `onClick`. The form's `onSubmit` then handles the click. Style the button with a reset on `border`, `background` and `font`.
- Gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events` and `jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions`.
- Side effect: the `div`'s `onClick` and the form's `onSubmit` both call the same handler. A mouse click on the `div` runs `onSubmit` directly. Pressing Enter in the field runs the form's `onSubmit`. A native submit button removes that split.

**Not checked.** The other levels' accessibility cards (module, service, system, codebase, production) and the change card `chg-ui-change-screenshots-and-keyboard-pass` need a diff, a stylesheet or a wider scope. Outside the ledger, `.btn` and any focus styling live elsewhere, so I can't say whether the focus indicator survives.

**Note, outside the accessibility scope:** `useState` isn't imported in `form.jsx`.
